task:
Explore map: a Layers pop-out with independent "Known-system density" and "My journeys" switches, each with its own legend and status (map review "Heatmaps: three products conflated"). apps/web only; no API change.

VERIFIED ON MAIN (dd45ee34):
- `ExploreWorkspace.svelte` `.map-layer-controls` holds three inline items: "Show/Hide nebulae" (`data-nebula-toggle`), "Show/Hide my travel heatmap" (`data-commander-history-toggle`, the signed-in account's journal travel) and the nebula status line. Public known-system density has NO user switch: its query is enabled purely by camera distance (`enabled: distance >= DENSITY_CROSSFADE_NEAR_LY` from `galaxy-detail-policy.ts`) and it now has its own status line with Retry (`data-density-state`, PR 982). The commander-history layer shows "Sign in and import your journals to see your travel heatmap" when enabled signed-out.
- Users cannot tell the three products apart: known-system density (public aggregate catalogue), My journeys (private, imported journals) and colony potential (NOT a working overlay yet; do not add it as a switch).

WHAT TO DO:
1. Replace the inline `.map-layer-controls` row with a **Layers** button that opens a non-modal pop-out (same pattern as `apps/web/src/lib/features/explore/BodyFilters.svelte` and the Plan facility picker: `role="dialog" aria-modal="false"`, positioned beside its trigger, clamped to the visual viewport, Escape and outside-click close, focus returns to the trigger). Inside, three rows, each a labelled switch (`role="switch"` with `aria-checked`) plus a one-line description, a small legend and its own status/error line:
   - **Known-system density** — default ON. Description: public aggregate of catalogue systems per cell; detail changes with zoom. Legend: the density colour ramp with "fewer / more systems" ends, the current cell size in LY and the generation label when known. Status: the existing density states from PR 982 (loading / ready / stale / unavailable / invalid / unpublished / empty / truncated) with its Retry button. Turning it OFF must disable the density query (no further requests), remove the density contribution and its cached cells from the scene (the layer disappears), and must NOT hide exact stars, change the camera or reset selection. Turning it back ON re-enables the query at the current zoom.
   - **My journeys** — default OFF. Description: your imported journal travel, private to your account. Status: signed-out → "Sign in and import your journals"; signed-in without journals → "No imported journals yet"; otherwise visit-count legend. This is the existing commander-history toggle moved here; keep its behaviour and tests.
   - **Nebulae** — the existing toggle, with the existing status text (catalogue records / landmarks shown) and attribution links.
   Keep the existing `data-*` hooks (`data-nebula-toggle`, `data-commander-history-toggle`, `data-density-state`, `data-nebula-resource-state`) on the new controls so Cypress specs keep working; add `data-density-toggle`. The Layers button shows a count of layers currently ON (e.g. "Layers · 2").
2. Persistence: remember the Known-system density and My journeys switch positions per browser in localStorage (wrapped in try/catch, keys namespaced under the existing persistence helpers in `apps/web/src/lib/persistence/` if one fits; otherwise a small helper). Nebulae keeps its current behaviour. Never persist anything about journal content.
3. Do not add a colony-potential switch. Do not change the density request parameters, the detail policy thresholds, or the renderer.

TESTS (vitest + component): switch roles and names; density OFF stops the query (`getMapHeatmap` not called again on a camera change), removes the contribution, keeps catalogue stars and camera; density ON again refetches; My journeys statuses for signed-out / no journals / with journals; Nebulae toggle unchanged; Escape/outside-click/focus return; persistence round-trip with localStorage throwing; axe has no violations on the open pop-out. Update any ExploreWorkspace/Cypress assertions that targeted the old inline row (keep selectors where possible) and say so in CHANGES.md. Existing tests must keep passing.

VALIDATION: in apps/web `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`. CHANGES.md: one dated 2026-11-02 entry; note this user-visible change needs Product E2E/visual validation before production promotion and is not deployed.
